```yaml
name: 🎙️ Deploy Call Kent Audio Worker
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'call-kent-audio-worker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-call-kent-audio-worker.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'call-kent-audio-worker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-call-kent-audio-worker.yml'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  NODE_VERSION: 24

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: 🚀 Deploy Worker
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      deployments: write
    steps:
      - name: ⬇️ Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: ⎔ Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}

      - name: 📥 Download deps
        run: npm ci

      - name: 🏗️ Build Worker
        run: npm run build
        working-directory: ./call-kent-audio-worker

      - name: 🚀 Deploy Worker
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          workingDirectory: ./call-kent-audio-worker
          command: deploy
          vars: |
            ENVIRONMENT="${{ github.ref_name }}"
            GITHUB_SHA="${{ github.sha }}"
          secrets: |
            CLOUDFLARE_QUEUE_ID="${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_QUEUE_ID }}"
            CLOUDFLARE_R2_BUCKET="${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_R2_BUCKET }}"
            CLOUDFLARE_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID="${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}"
            CLOUDFLARE_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}"

            CLOUDFLARE_AUDIO_CONTAINER_AUTH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_AUDIO_CONTAINER_AUTH_TOKEN }}"

            CLOUDFLARE_AUDIO_CONTAINER_CALLBACK_SECRET="${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_AUDIO_CONTAINER_CALLBACK_SECRET }}"
            CLOUDFLARE_AUDIO_CONTAINER_CALLBACK_TIMEOUT="${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_AUDIO_CONTAINER_CALLBACK_TIMEOUT }}"

    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'call-kent-audio-worker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-call-kent-audio-worker.yml'

    paths:
      - 'call-kent-audio-worker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-call-kent-audio-worker.yml'

concurrency:

  cancel-in-progress: true
